paragraphs.text: Iv'g'nork was a half- demon Rakdos slaver from Ravnica . He sold a bomb-goblin that was used for the assassination attempt at Saint Bayul . He was a visitor of Pivlic 's restaurant. He fought in a pit against Kos and Jarad , who wanted to get information from him. He was defeated by Jarad's insects that crawled into his body and started to consume him. In the end, he gave Kos and Jarad the info they came for and gave them a lift from the pit. It is highly probable that he was killed by the quietmen shortly afterward or that he died of the results of the damage inflicted by Jarad's bugs.
